title.narrative: AAP 2018 Investment Climate - Technical Assistance Facility for Sustainable Investment Climate - Rapid Response Window for SB4A

description.narrative: The overall objective of the proposed program is to support the formulation by beneficiary countries, of activities that attract sustainable private investments, enable economic diversification, sustainable management of resources and decent job creation which is inclusive. The program will support (i) diagnostics, (ii) technical assistance, and (iii) analytical work.
